dedupe_keys.name: a high resolution perspective view road image dataset for pothole detection

description: A high-resolution perspective-view road image dataset for pothole detection is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Hanshen Chen et al. Potholes are a critical infrastructure distress that damages vehicles and creates safety risks, motivating timely detection for effective maintenance. Automated detection via computer vision is a scalable solution, but its progress is hindered by the scarcity of high-quality, large-scale public datasets. Here we present HRP4K, a high-resolution, perspective-view road image dataset for developing and evaluating pothole detectors. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. Formats: JSON, TXT, Image. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
